from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,difflib
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class Page(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self,data):
  super().__init__(); self.links=[]; self.feed(data.decode('utf-8'))
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  if tag=='a': self.links.extend(value for name,value in attrs if name=='href')
root=Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement')
site=Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
served=(root/'placement-live-readback.html').read_bytes()
preview=(root/'director-buyer-preview/index-preview.html').read_bytes()
draft=(site/'index.html').read_bytes()
sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
receipt=json.loads((root/'director-buyer-preview/verification.json').read_text())
assert sha(served)==receipt['baseline_sha256'] and sha(preview)==receipt['preview_sha256']
marker=b'</body>'
assert served.count(marker)==preview.count(marker)==1
before,after=served.split(marker)
assert preview.startswith(before) and preview.endswith(marker+after)
insertion=preview[len(before):len(preview)-len(marker+after)]
assert insertion.strip() and Page(served).links==Page(preview).links
assert b'SYN-B-BL-XXL' in insertion
assets={str(p.relative_to(site)):sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(site.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p!=site/'index.html'}
patch=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(served.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),preview.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='served/index.html',tofile='worked-example/index.html'))
record={'served_sha256':sha(served),'worked_example_index_sha256':sha(preview),'concurrent_draft_sha256':sha(draft),'body_insertion_sha256':sha(insertion),'removing_insertion_restores_served_bytes':True,'inquiry_and_download_links_unchanged':True,'current_draft_other_files_sha256':assets,'scope':'Offline handoff. Other-file hashes describe the current draft inventory. Compare them to the last verified release inventory before treating them as a release baseline.'}
out=root/'release-owner-handoff'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(out/'worked-example-only.diff').write_text(patch,encoding='utf-8')
(out/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(record))
